# Assessment Question Patterns

## Predict the outcome
Given a model/configuration change, predict what will happen and explain why.

## Diagnose the symptom
Given learning curves, logs, metrics, or outputs, identify the likely failure and next action.

## Choose the next experiment
Given limited evidence and several interventions, select the highest-information or highest-value experiment.

## Compare two approaches
Choose between two models/architectures/workflows for a stated constraint and defend the trade-off.

## Correct the misconception
Present a plausible but incorrect statement and ask for a correction.

## Transfer scenario
Apply a concept to a new domain not used in the original example.

## Explain the mechanism
Ask what is happening internally, not merely what API call to use.
